{{Quote|He was a freedom fighter, a hero to our people during a war fought with a neighboring world.|[[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], on [[Arwen Cohl]]|<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />}}
This '''war''' took place several years before the [[Dorvalla Incident]], and saw the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mirial/Legends|Mirial]] fight against a neighboring world. Thanks in part to the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] freedom fighter [[Arwen Cohl]], Mirial emerged victorious.
